package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

// scenario for shared_package_named_common_base_utils_with_mixed_exports: Generic packages that mix services, models, DTOs, validators, and queries behind one broad shared namespace.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

const MaxUploadSize = 10 << 20
const DefaultPageSize = 25

type UserRole string

const (
	RoleAdmin UserRole = "admin"
	RoleUser  UserRole = "user"
)

func IsValidEmail(email string) bool {
	return strings.Contains(email, "@") && strings.Contains(email, ".")
}

func FormatCurrency(cents int64) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("$%.2f", float64(cents)/100)
}

type OrderDTO struct {
	ID     int64  `json:"id"`
	Status string `json:"status"`
}

func ProcessOrder(order *OrderDTO) error {
	if order.Status == "" {
		order.Status = "pending"
	}
	if order.ID <= 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid order id: %d", order.ID)
	}
	return nil
}
